entries.name: long-video-director

request.zh: 跨段人物/场景一致的长叙事

entries.description: Orchestrate and review provider-generated long-video workflows. Use for multi-part generated clips, over-15s provider output, consistent anchors across clips, per-segment storyboards, or transitions between generated clips. Do not use when the user explicitly requests Studio Run, Remotion, or an editable Composition workflow.

entries.name: video-edit

request.en: Faithfully recreate reference shot structure with replacement content
request.zh: 按参考片镜头结构精确复刻、替换内容

entries.description: Edit, transform, or faithfully recreate a supplied video. Use for source-preserving trims, repairs, captions, audio, effects, and subject/background replacement, or when a reference video's timing, camera, action, transitions, and beat structure must be reproduced with new content. Distinguishes source-edit from replication internally; use direct generation for a new video with no source authority and reference-video-studio for loose inspiration.

entries.name: explainer-video

request.en: Explain a topic, product or process

entries.description: Create an explainer video about a topic, product, feature, company, or process. Prefer complete native audiovisual generation for generated scenes within the selected model limit; use Remotion for authored diagrams, source-led assembly or explicit editability.

entries.name: cinematic-video

request.en: Trailer, teaser, brand film or cinematic short
request.zh: 预告片、品牌短片、电影感叙事

entries.description: Produce an authored trailer, teaser, launch film, mood piece, or cinematic short with shot-led storytelling, deliberate sound design, and a distinct visual language; use editable composition only when required by the result.

entries.name: talking-head
entries.description: Edit talking-head footage with transcript-led cuts, synced captions, B-roll, and highlights; continue through video-translate for another language and tiktok-video for TikTok/Douyin delivery.
entries.inputHint: A talking-head video with clear, audible speech

entries.name: video-translate

request.zh: 现有视频翻译、配音、本地化

entries.description: Translate accepted video into another language; compose first with talking-head when visible-speaker cuts are requested and finish through tiktok-video for TikTok/Douyin. Use Seed Audio for off-screen VO and SeeDance 2.0 for a visible speaker.

entries.name: tiktok-video

request.en: Package existing source footage for TikTok/Douyin
request.zh: 用已有素材制作 TikTok/抖音成片

entries.description: Package accepted source-led footage for TikTok/Douyin in editable Remotion; compose first with talking-head and video-translate for visible-speaker editing or translation.

entries.name: multi-angle-video

request.en: Whole-take multi-angle re-shoot preserving the performance/timebase
request.zh: 保留整段表演和时间线，重新制作多机位

entries.description: Whole-take multi-angle/multi-camera re-shoot of a supplied performance, preserving recorded content and source clock. Bounded scene/interval camera edits belong to video-edit instead; simple crops and existing multicam synchronization use ordinary editing.

entries.name: photo-to-video

request.en: Explicitly create progressive story images before video
request.zh: 明确要求先做渐进故事图片，再生成视频

entries.description: Use when the user explicitly selects Photo-to-Video or asks to create progressive story images before making a video. Single photo evolves into a wild 3-act visual story; multiple photos are selected and sequenced. Ordinary photo animation or requests for an interesting, stylish video do not by themselves activate this workflow.
